mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which positively impacts consumer confidence and spending, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is low but S&P 500 returns are negative, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5%, it indicates tight monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, thus negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS >5% but S&P 500 returns are positive, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: If employment (PAYEMS) grows while unemployment (UNRATE) rises, it may signal labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS grows with UNRATE rising but returns are positive, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high GDP (GDPC1) with slowing industrial production (INDPRO) may signal an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 is high and INDPRO slows but returns are positive, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises but returns are negative, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS grows >5% but returns are negative, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: If housing starts (HOUST) rise but GDP growth (GDPC1) slows, it may indicate economic imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST rises with GDPC1 slowing but returns are positive, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, if inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3%, it may lead to further rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL >3% but returns are positive, or Rank IC <0.03.
